units.source_text: 我向來無法把別人強塞給我的素材寫成小說，所以我本想當場還給她，

en.t: I have never been able to turn material forced on me by someone else into a novel, so I meant to hand it back to her on the spot,

units.source_text: 但卻被那幾張照片所吸引（關於那三張照片的怪異之處，我在序曲裡已提及），

en.t: but I was drawn in by those photographs (I have already mentioned the strangeness of the three photographs in the prologue),

units.source_text: 於是，我決定姑且先代為保管幾天，等回去時再順道拐來還給她。

en.t: so I decided to keep them for her for a few days for the time being, and to stop by on my way back and return them to her.

units.source_text: 我問老闆娘，住在某某街某某號名叫某某女士的女子大學講師，你知道嗎，

en.t: I asked the proprietress whether she knew a certain woman, a lecturer at a women's university, who lived at such-and-such number on such-and-such street,

units.source_text: 老闆娘說知道，因為她們都是剛遷來的新住戶，

en.t: and the proprietress said she did, since they were both new residents who had just moved into the area,

units.source_text: 老闆娘接著還說，我的這位講師朋友有時會來店裡喝咖啡，就住在附近。

en.t: then added that this lecturer friend of mine sometimes came to the shop for coffee and lived nearby.

units.source_text: 那天晚上，我和這位講師朋友喝了點酒，打算住在她家。

en.t: That evening, I had a little to drink with this lecturer friend and planned to stay at her house.
